name: DB HiTek CO., LTD.
summary: DB HiTek CO., LTD. engages in semiconductor foundry business in South Korea. It provides semiconductors, such as wireless chargers, power delivery systems, motor driver ICs, class D amplifiers, power management ICs, battery management ICs, and gate drivers used in mobile phones, industrial, computers/servers, medical equipment, and automobile applications. The company's processing technologies include BCDMOS, analog CMOS, high voltage CMOS, mixed signal, CIS, flash, logic. DB HiTek CO., LTD. was founded in 1997 and is based in Bucheon-si, South Korea.
